mathematical_result.statement: For three independent uniform m-cube blocks and U the three normalized block-sum directions, E||rho_(U^T X|Z)||_infinity^(2/3)=m^(-1)[Gamma(m+1)Gamma(4/3)/Gamma(m+1/3)]^3 > Gamma(4/3)^3 m. The same conditional law occurs for a full-rank QFORM matrix with spectrum {1,1,-1,1/128,...,1/128}.
mathematical_result.implication: A universal full-complement conditional 3-D sup-density 2/3-moment bound cannot be the missing QFORM bridge.

partner_result_applied.application: With LPP cap sqrt(2), Y1^2+Y2^2 has density cap 2pi and square smoothing gives ||p_(Y1^2+Y2^2-Y3^2)||_infinity <=4sqrt(pi).

other_completed_result_applied.application: For epsilon=1/128 and m>=32, high-spectrum leverage is 1/m<=1/32, hence the full-rank perturbation has continuous density <=288sqrt(3e)/13<64.

unresolved_implication: Prove an exhaustive product-preserving aggregate/ridge versus high-leverage grouped-coordinate dichotomy from only the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis, without conditioning away the product smoothing.
